contract.costs:
Pay rational Groebner membership, actual class access, factorial arithmetic, all support/output encodings and precision. Finite-class finiteness can instead use the separately supplied elementary closure-versus-pumping search, paying all explored states/paths and arithmetic; the record establishes computable termination, not efficiency. Exact finite-witness verification has a computable bound polynomial in complete input B, support count s, value encoding F, log(j+1), and2^(B+H_x). Conditional zero-gap search halts for each j on zero-gap inputs, but no uniform input-and-j search bound for the requested full algorithm is established. Real quantifier elimination is used only for a sufficient full-orthant condition; no efficiency claim.

Class character tests use exact membership and factorial tails to certify STRICT witness inequalities, without a Z oracle; no character-completeness or uniform general search bound. The one-species constructor pays extended Euclid, the explicit signed-jump word, finite prefix/tail graph, factorial powers and rational path resistances. H=10+2^B+a+L+max|s_j| gives the supplied conservative(10+H)^40 BIT bound and accumulated rational height<=(10+H)^8. H is explicitly computed, not an oracle; no polynomial-in-B or practical cost is claimed.

Finite motifs are additional certified input of size S. Exact polynomial expansion, coefficient heights, factorial tails, reachability paths and indicator evaluation have computable BIT bounds in B+S+log(j+1) plus query size, not a bound discovering all motifs. Rank-one class compilation pays primitive/gcd/Bezout data, signed words, finite interval or prefix/tail graphs, rational population factorials, path lifting and resistance sums; the supplied explicit computed H admits a conservative2^(H^20) BIT/description bound. No polynomial/practical mixing claim, normalizer oracle or chain simulation.
